verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships Loop, a first-party AI agent that lets users investigate logs in natural language instead of writing queries and ask it to build scorers, datasets, dashboards and evals. Its official MCP server also lets users query logs, author prompts and scorers, configure monitoring and run evals by talking to coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that Loop works well in practice, and in-depth docs on how far natural-language control reaches beyond data investigation and artifact creation (e.g., admin and settings operations).
